name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders and kitchen for food trucks
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from excess orders and keep serving when the signal is missing. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Your staff see all orders on a single screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare, then mark them as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it: so the queue keeps pace with the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add counter (walk-up) orders on the same screen as orders placed in advance, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

ONE SINGLE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen monitor shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is ready, with an alert when an order needs starting.

PRINT THE ORDER TICKETS
Connect a thermal printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or through your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN THE SIGNAL IS MISSING
Turn on offline protection: if the connection drops, advance orders pause, so nobody sends an order you wouldn’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sync when you’re back online.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and your locations once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is designed for food truck operators and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
